rationales.Style No: Style number is the manufacturer's identifier for the product model; it repeats across colour and size rows, while gtin carries the variant level code.
rationales.Style Name: Marketing name of the style; the CDM has no product name field.
rationales.Gender: Target consumer segment; the CDM has no field for it.
rationales.Fabric Content: Fibre content with percentages (60% organic cotton, 40% recycled polyester).
rationales.Fabric Wt (gsm): Fabric areal density in g/m2; netWeight is the weight of the finished product, so it does not match.
rationales.Country of Origin: Country where the product was made.
rationales.Factory: Legal name of the company that makes the garment.
rationales.Factory ID: Identifier code of the production facility (LKA-0412).
rationales.HTS Code: Customs tariff classification for the product.
rationales.Main Label: Describes the type of label sewn into the garment (woven neck label); not a CDM attribute.
rationales.UPC/EAN: 13 digit values with EAN-13 structure, one per variant, which is a GTIN-13.
rationales.Carton Qty: Packing quantity per carton; logistics data.
rationales.FOB Price (USD): Commercial price; outside the passport scope.
rationales.Lead Time (days): Production lead time; commercial planning data.
rationales.Rev: Revision number of the tech pack document, not the product.
rationales.Approved By: Internal approver name for the tech pack; no matching CDM field.
rationales.Comments: Free text QC and approval notes (wash test, shade band); not a structured conformity declaration.
rationales.Recycled Fibre (%): Share of recycled fibre in the product (40%), consistent with the 40% recycled polyester in Fabric Content.
